Fluix Crystal is the backbone reagent of Applied Energistics 2. Every cable, every processor, every storage cell needs it.

Making one is simple: drop a Charged Certus Quartz Crystal, a Nether Quartz, and Redstone Dust into water. They combine on contact into a Fluix Crystal. No machine required, just a water source block.

You will need hundreds of these before your ME network is functional. Set up an automated drop line that funnels ingredients into a water pool and collects the output.

§9Note:§f A single water source block can convert multiple stacks at once. You do not need one block per crystal.

§cWARNING:§f Do not forget the Redstone. Without it, the conversion does not happen.
